estimate_qualification: Subjective and uncalibrated; not a correctness probability.
new_partial: Unrestricted SU(3) classification under a Hermitian sum-of-squares certificate, permitting arbitrary complex character combinations and non-diagonal Gram matrices.
exact_gap: No proof that every pointwise nonnegative integral mean-one virtual character belongs to this SOS cone, and no counterexample. Other higher-rank groups also remain unresolved.
counterexample_to_weaker_implication: The nonnegative Weyl discriminant has integral virtual coefficients and is not Hermitian SOS, but its Haar mean is 15, so it does not answer the source question.
